about: Saint-Georges is the principal city of the Beauce, on the rivière Chaudière south of Québec City. It is a regional industrial and service centre for a countryside known for small manufacturers and a strong entrepreneurial culture. A waterfall park, a long main street along the river, and the Beauce hills frame the city. About 33,000 people live in Saint-Georges.
seoSummary: Beauce regional city on the rivière Chaudière, known for its falls and a small-manufacturing hinterland.
